# Units

A quantity is written as a number in the field's SI unit, or as a string of a number and one of these units (04 §7.1). Units are case-sensitive.

| Measures | SI unit | Units |
|----------|---------|-------|
| <a id="time"></a>time | `s` | `us` `ms` `s` `min` `h` `d` |
| <a id="length"></a>length | `m` | `mm` `cm` `m` `km` |
| <a id="volume"></a>volume | `m3` | `ml` `L` |
| <a id="mass"></a>mass | `kg` | `g` `kg` `t` |
| <a id="energy"></a>energy | `J` | `J` `kJ` `MJ` `GJ` |
| <a id="power"></a>power | `W` | `W` `kW` `MW` |
| <a id="force"></a>force | `N` | `N` `kN` |
| <a id="pressure"></a>pressure | `Pa` | `Pa` `kPa` `MPa` `GPa` |
| <a id="temperature"></a>temperature | `K` | `K` `C` |

## Rates

A rate is a unit followed by one of `/s`, `/min`, `/h`, `/d`: `"0.012 kg/s"`, `"2 C/s"`. A plain rate has no unit before the slash: `"0.15 /h"`. A speed is a length per time and a power an energy per time, so `"18 km/h"` and `"5 J/s"` are read too. A rate of temperature is a difference: `"2 C/s"` is two kelvin a second.

| Measures | SI unit | Also written |
|----------|---------|--------------|
| <a id="rate"></a>rate | `/s` | `/s` `/min,` `/h,` |
| <a id="time-per-time"></a>time per time | `s/s` | `us/s` `ms/s` `s/s` `min/s` `h/s` `d/s` `/min,` `/h,` |
| <a id="speed"></a>speed | `m/s` | `mm/s` `cm/s` `m/s` `km/s` `/min,` `/h,` |
| <a id="volume-rate"></a>volume rate | `m3/s` | `ml/s` `L/s` `/min,` `/h,` |
| <a id="mass-rate"></a>mass rate | `kg/s` | `g/s` `kg/s` `t/s` `/min,` `/h,` |
| <a id="power"></a>power | `W` | `W` `kW` `MW` `J/s` `kJ/s` `MJ/s` `GJ/s` `/min,` `/h,` |
| <a id="force-rate"></a>force rate | `N/s` | `N/s` `kN/s` `/min,` `/h,` |
| <a id="pressure-rate"></a>pressure rate | `Pa/s` | `Pa/s` `kPa/s` `MPa/s` `GPa/s` `/min,` `/h,` |
| <a id="temperature-rate"></a>temperature rate | `K/s` | `K/s` `C/s` `/min,` `/h,` |

In an expression only the units that are a scale may follow a number, without a slash: `300ms`, `70kPa`. `C` is an offset and is not one of them (05 §4.7).
